EPFO Allows Monthly PF Withdrawals, Reduces Minimum Balance Rule

The Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) has announced three significant decisions. Employees will now be able to withdraw funds from their Provident Fund (PF) accounts on a monthly basis. Additionally, the minimum balance requirement has been reduced to 10%. These changes are expected to impact private sector employees, allowing them to access their PF funds similarly to a pension.
